title: Women in Andhra's movement: more names and roles

boxes.title: Leaders: added detail
items: Durgabai at Kakinada: arranged Gandhi's meeting with ==**Devadasis** and Muslim women==
Nehru episode placed at **Vijayawada AICC (1921)**; ⚠ many accounts: **Kakinada Congress (1923)**
Durgabai in Madras CDM with **K. Nageswara Rao**, T. Prakasam; Constituent Assembly "founding mother"
Subbamma: Vijayawada AICC **1921**; ==**Neil statue satyagraha**==; arrested at Rajahmundry
Lakshmibayamma: **Sri Sarada Niketanam** monthly; 1902 asylum merged into Gurukulam
Niketanam: "hotbed" of the movement; widows, destitute girls
